title: Follow Frame
description: A dashed frame that trails the cursor and names the action waiting there.
usage: For playful surfaces — onboarding, product tours, marketing panels. One frame per surface, and the label must name a real action.
a11y: Pointer-only by design; touch and keyboard users lose nothing, since the frame carries no information the panel itself does not. It parks, centered, under prefers-reduced-motion.
